create.title: New campaign
create.description: Answer three questions. You get a brief you can edit before launch.
create.note: The brief is drafted from your answers and your workspace profile — by the AI provider when one is configured, otherwise from a template.

selling.ask: First — what are you selling? A sentence is enough.
selling.placeholder: What you sell, in one sentence
selling.example: Payroll software for companies with 20 to 200 employees

buyer.example: Finance leads and CFOs at European SaaS companies

goal.ask: What's the goal — sign-ups, demos, awareness?
goal.placeholder: What a reader should do after the post
goal.example: Demo requests from companies with more than 50 employees

stepHints.basics: Name the campaign, then set the post-by date and the fee you offer per post.
stepHints.brief: Every creator you invite writes from this brief. Edit anything before launch.
stepHints.creators: Ranked by fit with this brief, the best few already ticked. Each invitation is funded from your wallet.
stepHints.review: Check the numbers, then launch: the campaign goes live and invitations go out.
